4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I held an empty glass, lost in thought.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: However, my moment of solitude was interrupted by the sound of the main throne room doors opening.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Lucita quickly entered and stopped before me. She was carrying a satchel.

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: “What are you doing here? I told the guards I wasn't to be disturbed.”

8.speaker: Lucita Azaro
8.text: “I apologize, but I had to see you. It's about the investigation into your father's death."

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: She produced a vial from her satchel.

12.speaker: Lucita Azaro
12.text: "After conducting a covert sweep of the Palace's medicine cabinets and storage closets, I found this vial hidden in the Armament Display, within King Henricus Toras' armor. The toxicologists confirmed it was the same substance."

13.speaker: Player_Romus
13.text: “I knew it! My misgivings toward Titus were right all along.”

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: I gripped the armrest lost in thought.

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: This room, with its heavy curtains and crackling fireplace, offered the respite I craved amidst the relentless tumult of my kingdom's affairs.

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: I looked up to see Titus quickly enter and stop before me. He was holding a briefcase.

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "Titus... to what do I owe this pleasure?"

29.speaker: Titus Gordion
29.text: “I apologize, sir, but I had to see you immediately. It's about the investigation into King Valero's death."

31.speaker: Titus Gordion
31.text: “And in fact, we now have reason to believe she committed the crime."

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: He produced a vial from his briefcase.

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: “I knew it! What could have possibly made her do such a thing?”

34.speaker: Titus Gordion
34.text: "You tasked the Golden Guard with investigating a potential connection involving Duchess Azaro."

35.speaker: Lucita Azaro
35.text: "You tasked me with investigating a potential connection involving Titus."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "You must be mistaken. I've come to know Titus well over the years, and he's not a murderer, at least not in that sense. His loyalty lies with the king."

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "My own wife. I don't know whether to feel relieved or devastated."

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: I reached behind the throne, pulled out a bottle of Romus the Red I had strategically hidden, and filled my glass.

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "I'd pour you a glass too, but... I don't want to."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "Here, let me pour you a glass. I'd rather not indulge alone."

54.speaker: Titus Gordion
54.text: "Thanks, but I'd prefer to abstain for the time being."

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: I rose from the throne and approached a hidden wall panel, revealing a selection of bottles and glasses.

56.speaker: Titus Gordion
56.text: "To be honest, after everything that's happened, I can't say I'm in the drinking mood."

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: With a slightly unsteady hand, I fetched a wine glass and filled it to the brim before handing it to Titus.

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: I held my glass up high.

61.speaker: Player_Romus
61.text: "To loyalty... the rarest gem in a sea of deceit and treachery."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "To lovers... may they find solace in the cold embrace of prison walls."

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: We clinked glasses and took a drink.

64.speaker: Titus Gordion
64.text: "And may their hearts be warmed by the iron bars of affection."

66.speaker: Titus Gordion
66.text: "As elusive as a unicorn in a field of politics."

67.speaker: Titus Gordion
67.text: "I assure you, I'm not. Given everything that just transpired, I'd probably be doing the same."

68.speaker: Titus Gordion
68.text: "If she's found guilty of her new charges, she could very well be incarcerated for the rest of her life."

69.speaker: Titus Gordion
69.text: "Perhaps it's better to face the truth, no matter how painful."

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "I can't believe it... so it is true..."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "You must be mistaken. Lucita is no saint, but I can assure you that she's not a murderer."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "I don't know whether to feel relieved or devastated. To think someone so close could be so treacherous."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "That evidence is circumstantial. Anyone could have put that vial there at any time."

78.speaker: Lucita Azaro
78.text: "Perhaps it's better to face the truth, no matter how painful.”

79.speaker: Lucita Azaro
79.text: "I am afraid the evidence says otherwise."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Lucita... to what do I owe the pleasure?"

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "I tasked you with that years ago. What new revelation could you possibly have for me?"

84.speaker: Lucita Azaro
84.text: "I had to see you. It's about the investigation into your father's death."

85.speaker: Titus Gordion
85.text: "I had to see you, sir. It's regarding the investigation into King Valreo's death."

86.speaker: Lucita Azaro
86.text: "Forgive my abruptness, but I had to see you. It concerns the investigation into your father's death."

87.speaker: Titus Gordion
87.text: "Forgive my abruptness, sir, but I had to see you. It concerns the investigation into King Valero's death."

91.speaker: Titus Gordion
91.text: "You see, when the late king was exhumed for investigation, a small sample of formalin-fixed tissue was preserved, allowing for long-term storage."

92.speaker: Titus Gordion
92.text: "With advancements in technology, laboratories at Iza University were able to conduct a more in-depth toxicology test using that very sample."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "After all this time, such a small tissue sample can still produce accurate results? I don't think so."

98.speaker: Titus Gordion
98.text: "I understand your skepticism, but the university's advancements -- with the Crown's funding, of course -- have revolutionized toxicology testing."

99.speaker: Titus Gordion
99.text: "The preserved tissue sample has allowed us to uncover crucial evidence with a high degree of accuracy."

101.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
101.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Titus"] > 2  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true)

102.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
102.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Titus"] > 2  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true)) == false

103.speaker: Player_Romus
103.text: "She's coming here now? I wish you'd told me about this sooner."

104.speaker: Titus Gordion
104.text: “Speaking of betrayal, there's another matter I'd like to address."
104.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Titus"] > 2  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true)

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "You did? Well, well... this should be interesting."

106.speaker: Titus Gordion
106.text: "My apologies, but I felt it necessary to hear from her as soon as possible."

107.speaker: Titus Gordion
107.text: "I'm not sure if 'interesting' is the word I'd use..."

108.speaker: Titus Gordion
108.text: "Regardless, this matter will have to be handled delicately or this could get very ugly with House Azaro."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "God dammit, Titus... I was not prepared for an interrogation."

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: I set my glass out of sight.

114.speaker: Titus Gordion
114.text: "My apologies, but I felt it imperative for you to hear from her at the earliest opportunity."

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "As if my relationship with House Azaro couldn't get any worse..."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "House Azaro should be burned to the ground -- literally and metaphorically."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "If that's true, I'm tempted to ensure that the Azaros foot the bill for it rather than the taxpayers."

118.speaker: Titus Gordion
118.text: "As you know, eyewitness accounts, including my own, describe an argument between the Grand Vizier and the late king taking place shortly before Valero's death."

119.speaker: Titus Gordion
119.text: "This gave reason for suspicion, alongside the rumored brotherly rivalry between them -- a tale akin to Léandrós and Juliano."

120.speaker: Narrator
120.text: The parable of Léandrós and Juliano was a well-known Nurist tale depicting two brothers whose blood feud culminated in their mutual demise.

121.speaker: Player_Romus
121.text: "Murder weapon? What murder weapon? This is news to me."

123.speaker: Narrator
123.text: Titus pulled out a vial from his jacket pocket.

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "After all this time, only now has a murder weapon been discovered?"

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "How did the existence of a murder weapon escape our attention until now?"

126.speaker: Titus Gordion
126.text: "As strange as it may seem, that's exactly what happened."

127.speaker: Titus Gordion
127.text: "I'm glad you've asked. We uncovered this."

132.speaker: Lucita Azaro
132.text: "In light of your dissolution of the Royal Council, I have ceased my investigation into Captain Titus Gordion."

133.speaker: Lucita Azaro
133.text: "Recently, a new toxicology report came to light, revealing the presence of Mandragora -- a deadly nightshade -- in your father's system."

134.speaker: Lucita Azaro
134.text: "While this finding is significant, it does not provide conclusive evidence linking Titus to the acquisition or possession of such a poison."

135.speaker: Lucita Azaro
135.text: "Despite my efforts to delve deeper into the matter, I have yet to uncover any substantial evidence implicating Titus in any wrongdoing."

136.speaker: Lucita Azaro
136.text: "I hope this update provides some clarity on the situation, and I wish you luck with your new government."

138.speaker: Lucita Azaro
138.text: "Eyewitness accounts initially led to suspicion surrounding Hugo's actions on the night of the late King's death."

139.speaker: Lucita Azaro
139.text: "However, while exploring a possible motive, it was discovered that rumors of a bitter rivalry between them were unsubstantiated."

140.speaker: Lucita Azaro
140.text: "In fact, Hugo shared a close and amicable relationship with his brother."

141.speaker: Lucita Azaro
141.text: "In regards to the toxicology report, recent findings unveiled the presence of mandragora, a deadly poison, in the late King's system."

142.speaker: Lucita Azaro
142.text: "This discovery sheds new light on the circumstances surrounding his death."

143.speaker: Lucita Azaro
143.text: "In light of your dissolution of the Royal Council, I have ceased my investigation into Hugo Toras. However, some new information did arise."

147.speaker: Narrator
147.text: With purposeful strides, a Golden Guardsman delivered a box laden with bulging files, placing it before me.

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: Upon his departure, I inspected the contents more closely and observed a handwritten envelope placed atop the pile, bearing my name. Intrigued, I proceeded to unseal it.

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: In this room, with its cozy atmosphere created by heavy curtains and a crackling fireplace, I found the tranquility I sought amidst the bustling affairs of my kingdom.

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: Alone, I sank more deeply into my seat.

158.speaker: Narrator
158.text: Despite all of our efforts, I realized then that I would never learn the truth.

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: Or perhaps there was no further truth to be found. Perhaps, in the end, the simplest explanation was the correct one.

163.speaker: Titus Gordion
163.text: "When I assumed command of Wruhec's Guardians, that responsibility was bestowed upon them as well."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "Luce, I dissolved the Royal Council. You didn't need to continue that assignment."

175.speaker: Lucita Azaro
175.text: "Can't a wife do her husband a favor?"

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: She approached the throne and smiled slyly.

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "Is there another explanation for how that drug got into my father's system?"

182.speaker: Titus Gordion
182.text: "If she's found guilty of her new charges, execution will be warranted."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "Now that I know my father wanted you as security councilor, feel free to petition for the General's seat."

191.speaker: Lucita Azaro
191.text: "As you know, it all started with accounts of an argument between the Grand Vizier and your father as they were heading to the King's chambers."

192.speaker: Lucita Azaro
192.text: "This alone gave reason for suspicion, alongside the rumored brotherly rivalry between them -- a tale akin to Léandrós and Juliano."

193.speaker: Narrator
193.text: Léandrós and Juliano was a well-known Nurist parable depicting two brothers whose blood feud culminated in their mutual demise.

194.speaker: Lucita Azaro
194.text: "But as I delved deeper, I uncovered a surprising truth. Hugo and your father shared a close bond, as seen through their correspondence and numerous testimonials."

195.speaker: Lucita Azaro
195.text: "There was no evidence indicating your uncle's desire to claim the throne. The rumored rivalry was simply a fabrication."

196.speaker: Lucita Azaro
196.text: "They found traces of mandragora. It's a deadly nightshade historically used to induce hallucinations. An overdose can result in death."

200.speaker: Lucita Azaro
200.text: "I found this vial hidden in the Armament Display, within King Henricus Toras' armor."

201.speaker: Lucita Azaro
201.text: "It seems to have belonged to Captain Titus Gordion."

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "Valero had to die so that our holy Wruhecist kingdom could rise. I am at peace with that now."

203.speaker: Titus Gordion
203.text: "Regardless, I think you'll want to hear about these new developments."

207.speaker: Titus Gordion
207.text: "You tasked the Golden Guard with investigating a potential connection involving Hugo Toras."

211.speaker: Titus Gordion
211.text: "When I assumed command of Wruhec's Guardians, that responsibility was bestowed upon them as well."

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "He's coming here now? I wish you'd informed me of this sooner."

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "You did? Well, well... this should be interesting."

214.speaker: Lucita Azaro
214.text: "My apologies, but I felt it necessary to hear from him as soon as possible."

215.speaker: Lucita Azaro
215.text: "I'm not sure if 'interesting' is the word I'd use..."

216.speaker: Player_Romus
216.text: "God dammit, Lucita... I was not prepared for an interrogation."

220.speaker: Narrator
220.text: I set my glass out of sight.

221.speaker: Lucita Azaro
221.text: "My apologies, but I felt it imperative for you to hear from him at the earliest opportunity."

222.speaker: Lucita Azaro
222.text: “While we are waiting, though, there's something I need to bring up with you."
222.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true)

223.speaker: Narrator
223.text: Lucita respectfully bowed her head before leaving.

226.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

227.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
227.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true)) == false

228.speaker: Narrator
228.text: Lucita placed a gentle kiss on my cheek before respectfully bowing her head and departing.

232.speaker: Lucita Azaro
232.text: "If there's nothing else you require of me, I'll take my leave and attend to other matters."

236.speaker: Lucita Azaro
236.text: "I know this isn't my department anymore, but I've had my ear to the ground."

240.speaker: Titus Gordion
240.text: "Your father died nearly eight years ago. As I understand it, from natural causes."

241.speaker: Titus Gordion
241.text: "Your father died nearly eight years ago. As I understand it, from natural causes."

242.speaker: Narrator
242.text: It was then that Titus burst through the doors past the Golden Guard sentries, waving an envelope.
242.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true)) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true) == false)

244.speaker: Narrator
244.text: The guards restrained him as he approached.

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: “Actually, Titus, I am their superior. The Golden Guard is sworn to protect me, even from guardsmen within.”

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: He took out the contents of the envelope and held it up.

249.speaker: Titus Gordion
249.text: “Lucita sent me this letter full of baseless claims linking me to His Majesty King Valero's murder."

250.speaker: Titus Gordion
250.text: "According to her note, she informed me ahead of time ‘out of respect’, to give me an opportunity to confess before she informed you --"

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: “Are you calling Duchess Azaro a liar?"

252.speaker: Titus Gordion
252.text: “Of course! She clearly planted the evidence to get rid of me."

253.speaker: Titus Gordion
253.text: “In fact, I wouldn't be surprised if the Duchess orchestrated your father's demise herself.”

254.speaker: Lucita Azaro
254.text: “Titus, your accusations are absurd as they are insulting. Trying to drag me into this is a sad act of desperation.”

256.speaker: Narrator
256.text: The room fell into a tense silence as the accusations hung in the air.

257.speaker: Player_Romus
257.text: “Any final words in your defense, Lucita?”
257.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_Vial"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_LucitaHow"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_LeftPost"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_CouncilJob"] == true

258.speaker: Lucita Azaro
258.text: “Titus is guilty, Your Majesty. No doubt about it.”

259.speaker: Player_Romus
259.text: “I'm sorry that it had to come to this.”

260.speaker: Narrator
260.text: Titus fought every step of the way, but the guard's grasp remained steadfast as dragged out of the throne room.

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: “Thank you, Lucita. You've done a great service by bringing this to my attention."

262.speaker: Lucita Azaro
262.text: “It was my duty, Your Majesty. I'm honored to have fulfilled your wishes.”

263.speaker: Narrator
263.text: Titus and Lucita closed their mouths, still fuming.

264.speaker: Player_Romus
264.text: “Titus, you've made a convincing case. Guards, take Ms. Azaro into custody.”

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "Your protests fall on deaf ears, Titus. Your fate is sealed."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "Well, that was undoubtedly one of the most unpleasant experiences I've had."

271.speaker: Player_Romus
271.text: "Yes, keep fighting. See how far that gets you."

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "Yes, I too thought it sounded a bit far-fetched."

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "What's sad is the possibility that someone in your position, Lucita, would go to such lengths to sabotage a colleague."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "So it's up to the King to make the final judgement. Titus, do you have anything else to say for yourself?"
274.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_Vial"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_LucitaHow"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_LeftPost"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_CouncilJob"] == true

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "I trust you, Lucita, and have no reason to believe otherwise. The only future for Titus is a future behind bars. Guards, arrest Captain Gordion now."

276.speaker: Titus Gordion
276.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. Your support means everything."

277.speaker: Titus Gordion
277.text: "It goes without saying that Duchess Azaro clearly planted the evidence to get rid of me."

278.speaker: Titus Gordion
278.text: "Calling it sabotage is putting it lightly."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "Lucita, can you explain why you felt the need to inform Titus in this manner?"

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "It's indeed sad, Captain. To witness a respected officer resort to baseless accusations in a desperate attempt to deflect suspicion."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "Oh, get the hell out of my sight!"

283.speaker: Lucita Azaro
283.text: "It was my duty, as it pertained to his involvement in the investigation. Transparency is essential in such matters."

284.speaker: Titus Gordion
284.text: "Then allow me to be transparent as well. Duchess Azaro clearly planted the evidence to get rid of me.”

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "Hit him in the back on the lower right side. That'll shut him up."

287.speaker: Titus Gordion
287.text: "I understand your skepticism, Your Majesty. However, if I may, I implore you to consider the facts."

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: Exhaling deeply, I settled back onto my throne.

289.speaker: Narrator
289.text: Despite Titus's best efforts, the guards maintained their hold, forcefully pulling him out of the throne room.

290.speaker: Narrator
290.text: Titus fought against their hold as they escorted him out of the throne room, but it was to no avail.

291.speaker: Narrator
291.text: One of the guards struck Titus as I'd instructed. He let out an anguished cry and collapsed to the ground.

293.speaker: Narrator
293.text: As the guards tightened their grip on his arms, Titus attempted to break away.

294.speaker: Titus Gordion
294.text: “No! You can’t do this! You’re making a terrible mistake!”

296.speaker: Lucita Azaro
296.text: "I, for one, certainly took no pleasure in informing you either."

303.speaker: Narrator
303.text: It was then that Titus burst through the doors past a couple of Wruhec's Guardians sentries, waving an envelope.

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: “Actually, Titus, I am their superior. The Wruhec's Guardians are sworn to protect me, even from guardsmen within.”

305.speaker: Player_Romus
305.text: "You are both overlooking one obvious suspect. Sal Ignacius."
305.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.SalExonerated"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Sal_Arrested"] == false)

309.speaker: Player_Romus
309.text: "You are both wrong. I submit that Hugo Toras was the guilty party after all."

314.speaker: Narrator
314.text: As the guards firmly gripped her arms, Lucita struggled against them, her voice raised in protest.

315.speaker: Lucita Azaro
315.text: “No! You can’t do this! You’re making a terrible mistake!”

316.speaker: Player_Romus
316.text: “I can, and I will. Your words are meaningless. Justice will be served.”

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: Lucita tried to resist, but the guards' hold remained steadfast as they dragged her out of the throne room.

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: The only mistake I made was marrying you."

323.speaker: Narrator
323.text: Lucita flashed a vicious scowl as she was dragged out of the throne room.

324.speaker: Player_Romus
324.text: "Say that again, only this time, really mean it."

326.speaker: Narrator

669.speaker: Player_Romus
669.text: "When my father argued with Hugo earlier that evening, he said 'He is not ready.' Could he have been talking about Titus?"
669.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Pardoned"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_FinalInvestigationClues_Conversation"] == false)

671.speaker: Player_Romus
671.text: "Is there any other explanation for how that substance got into my father's system?"

673.speaker: Lucita Azaro
673.text: "It's possible. I always did find it suspicious that Captain Gordion claimed not to have overheard that argument."

686.speaker: Player_Romus
686.text: "I won't bother you with questions about this. I need answers from the man himself."

689.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
689.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_FinalInvestigationClues_OtherExplanation"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_FinalInvestigationClues_Document"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_FinalInvestigationClues_Conversation"] == false) == false

690.speaker: Player_Romus
690.text: "I've heard enough. What does Titus himself have to say about all this?"
690.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_FinalInvestigationClues_OtherExplanation"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_FinalInvestigationClues_Document"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_FinalInvestigationClues_Conversation"] == false) == false

691.speaker: Lucita Azaro
691.text: "No. Titus and his men have been allowed to roam the Palace with impunity since the Golden Guard was reinstated. They could have entered the archives and destroyed it at any time."

692.speaker: Lucita Azaro
692.text: "Your father could have taken it himself. His medicine stores were cleared out long before this investigation began."

696.speaker: Lucita Azaro
696.text: "There's still a small possibility that either Hugo or the Grand Wiseman slipped the poison to him."

697.speaker: Lucita Azaro
697.text: "Alternately, the Grand Vizier could have administered it to him. The two of them were alone in your father's room for several minutes."

698.speaker: Lucita Azaro
698.text: "But the discovery of the vial in Titus' possession, combined with the motive I've just unearthed, strongly points towards the Captain as our primary suspect."

700.speaker: Lucita Azaro
700.text: "You'll get them. I sent Captain Gordion a summons. He should be arriving any minute."

701.speaker: Lucita Azaro
701.text: "We'll find out shortly. I sent Captain Gordion a summons. He should be arriving any minute."

702.speaker: Player_Romus
702.text: "Captain Gordion has not been proven guilty yet. Unhand him at once."

703.speaker: Narrator
703.text: The guards apologized and let go of Titus' arms. My guardsman produced an envelope.

704.speaker: Narrator
704.text: His gaze shifted between the two of us.

705.speaker: Titus Gordion
705.text: "She's viewed Wruhec's Guardians as a threat ever since you and the Grand Wiseman established them."

709.speaker: Titus Gordion
709.text: "She's viewed the Golden Guard as a threat ever since we were reinstated."

710.speaker: Titus Gordion
710.text: "Need I remind you that I am the man standing between you and a full takeover of the throne by House Azaro?"

712.speaker: Player_Romus
712.text: "Captain Gordion, how did that vial Duchess Azaro found come into your possession?"

717.speaker: Player_Romus
717.text: "Titus, is it true that you went after the security councilor position after General Azaro fell ill?"

725.speaker: Player_Romus
725.text: "Why did you leave your post the night King Valero died, Captain Gordion?"

726.speaker: Player_Romus
726.text: "I'll bite. If Lucita was responsible for poisoning my father, why and how would she have done it?"

735.speaker: Titus Gordion
735.text: "My old boxing injury flared up. The pain became too much to bear, and I went to an unused guest room to recuperate."

739.speaker: Titus Gordion
739.text: "Back in my boxing days, I sustained a kidney injury that never fully healed."

740.speaker: Titus Gordion
740.text: "It still flares up occasionally -- like during my fight in Derdia. And unfortunately, on the night His Majesty died."

744.speaker: Titus Gordion
744.text: "It still flares up occasionally. Unfortunately, it did so on the night His Majesty died."

745.speaker: Titus Gordion
745.text: "The pain became too much to bear, and I crept off to an unused guest room to recuperate."

749.speaker: Titus Gordion
749.text: "The drug is mine, Your Majesty. I'll admit that."

750.speaker: Titus Gordion
750.text: "Back in my boxing days, I sustained a kidney injury that never fully healed."

751.speaker: Titus Gordion
751.text: "I take wolfsbane to manage the pain."

755.speaker: Titus Gordion
755.text: "I take it to manage the pain from that old boxing injury I told you about."

756.speaker: Titus Gordion
756.text: "Respectfully, Your Majesty, all you have is Duchess Azaro's word that this vial was found in my quarters."

757.speaker: Titus Gordion
757.text: "She herself could have manufactured it after reading the toxicology report."

758.speaker: Titus Gordion
758.text: "Or used it the night Valero died, and waited until just this moment to pin the crime on me."

761.speaker: Lucita Azaro
761.text: "You knew the Grand Wiseman was drugging Valero, and you happened to have a medicine in your possession that would augment that drug's effects."

762.speaker: Lucita Azaro
762.text: "He must have gone after Valero as an act of revenge. Or in the hope that the King's successor would grant him a second chance at a council seat..."

765.speaker: Titus Gordion
765.text: "I was too embarrassed to have mentioned it to you. I was completely unqualified at the time."

766.speaker: Titus Gordion
766.text: "Of course, I would not say the same now."

768.speaker: Titus Gordion
768.text: "Or you used it on the king yourself, knowing it would implicate me."

770.speaker: Titus Gordion
770.text: "One of my guards took my place when I had to leave my post. He must have let her in."

771.speaker: Titus Gordion
771.text: "I knew there was a reason he resigned so suddenly after King Valero's death..."

772.speaker: Titus Gordion
772.text: "As for a motive -- Duchess Azaro may have thought her chances of taking the Rizian throne were higher with a young, single king than with his married, elderly father."

774.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

775.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_Vial"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_LucitaHow"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_LeftPost"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_TitusInterrogation_CouncilJob"] == true) == false

778.speaker: Lucita Azaro
778.text: "I came to you with this evidence. Don't you trust your own wife?"
778.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

782.speaker: Lucita Azaro
782.text: "After all these years -- everything we've been through -- you still don't trust me?"
782.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

784.speaker: Player_Romus
784.text: "Yes, I've heard enough of these insinuations, Titus."

785.speaker: Player_Romus
785.text: "I'm not convinced. Something about this doesn't add up."

790.speaker: Player_Romus
790.text: "Ha. As if the Duchess ever had a chance with me."

793.speaker: Player_Romus
793.text: "You sure didn't wait long to move in on me, Duchess."

798.speaker: Player_Romus
798.text: "I wish that it didn't have to come to this."

805.speaker: Player_Romus
805.text: "He's the only person my father might have told about the mandragora ritual. And the only one my father would have trusted to administer an innocent-sounding painkiller."

809.speaker: Player_Romus
809.text: "No, none of this matters anymore. And it's not worth the lengthy trial our new government will inevitably demand."

810.speaker: Player_Romus
810.text: "No. It is up to God to judge him."

812.speaker: Lucita Azaro
812.text: "I still think you shouldn't ignore the evidence against the Captain. But it's not my decision to make."

816.speaker: Player_Romus
816.text: "No, none of this matters anymore. And it's not worth the lengthy trial our new government will inevitably demand."

817.speaker: Player_Romus
817.text: "No. It is up to God to judge him."

819.speaker: Titus Gordion
819.text: "The evidence against the Duchess seemed very compelling to me. But it's your decision, Your Majesty."

820.speaker: Narrator
820.text: Lucita approached and knelt before me.

821.speaker: Player_Romus
821.text: "I have made up my mind. Grand Wiseman Ignacius was the sole person involved in my father's death. It is finally time for him to answer for his crime."

828.speaker: Player_Romus
828.text: "We already have his diary and his bottle of poison. Why make things more complicated?"

829.speaker: Player_Romus
829.text: "My father could just as easily have been taking wolfsbane on his own. None of this extra evidence convinces me."

830.speaker: Player_Romus
830.text: "No questions. We all know he's guilty."

834.speaker: Lucita Azaro
834.text: "In that case, I'll have him apprehended right away."

838.speaker: Lucita Azaro
838.text: "It'll still have to go through the courts, but it's an open-and-shut case."

842.speaker: Titus Gordion
842.text: "In that case, I'll have him apprehended right away."

846.speaker: Titus Gordion
846.text: "It'll still have to go through the courts, but it's an open-and-shut case."

847.speaker: Lucita Azaro
847.text: "I'm sorry about Gordion. But I did warn you against giving in to his request for expansion."

849.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
849.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == false

851.text: "If you'll excuse me, I have no business in the Palace these days. My duties in Montaklar are calling."

852.text: "If that will be all, I'll see you soon."

859.speaker: Player_Romus
859.text: "Captain. How are Wruhec's Guardians handling their new duties?"

860.speaker: Titus Gordion
860.text: "Very well, sir. In fact... there's been a breakthrough in the investigation into your father's death."

864.speaker: Titus Gordion
864.text: "After the Grand Wiseman's exoneration, you tasked the Golden Guard with investigating a potential connection involving Duchess Azaro."

868.speaker: Titus Gordion
868.text: "After the Grand Wiseman's exoneration, you tasked the Golden Guard with investigating a potential connection involving Hugo Toras."

872.speaker: Titus Gordion
872.text: "However, our investigation was not entirely fruitless. We have new findings to report."

876.speaker: Titus Gordion
876.text: "With advancements in technology, laboratories at Romus Toras University were able to conduct a more in-depth toxicology test using that very sample."

880.speaker: Titus Gordion
880.text: "They found traces of mandragora. A highly potent hallucinogen, known to cause death in large enough doses."

881.speaker: Titus Gordion
881.text: "The tests confirmed the presence of mandragora in the king's system. But we also asked the technicians to test for less lethal toxins."

882.speaker: Titus Gordion
882.text: "They found traces of a plant called wolfsbane."

883.speaker: Player_Romus
883.text: "Wolfsbane? Are we back in fantasy world?"

885.speaker: Player_Romus
885.text: "What? How many drugs was my father on?"

886.speaker: Titus Gordion
886.text: "Wolfsbane is used medicinally as a painkiller. But it can also cause cardiac arrest in large enough doses."

887.speaker: Titus Gordion
887.text: "This is a real plant, Your Majesty. Just like mandragora."

888.speaker: Titus Gordion
888.text: "The amount found in your father's bloodstream wasn't enough to kill him. But in combination with mandragora..."

889.speaker: Titus Gordion
889.text: "We went back through the belongings we confiscated after Duchess Azaro's arrest and found this in a shadow box containing her medals and insignia. The liquid inside is an exact match to the chemical the tests found."

893.speaker: Narrator
893.text: He raised the vial he was holding. Looking closer, I saw a perfume label on it.

894.speaker: Titus Gordion
894.text: "We conducted a covert search of Duchess Azaro's residence and found this in a shadow box containing her medals and insignia. The liquid inside is an exact match to the chemical the tests found."
894.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseAzaro_Conquered"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true) == false)

898.speaker: Titus Gordion
898.text: "There's more. We found a possible motive."

899.speaker: Narrator
899.text: He pulled out a plastic bag containing a document.

900.speaker: Titus Gordion
900.text: "This is the royal order naming Lucita Azaro interim security councilor in the wake of her father's illness. Signed the very day of King Valero's death."

901.speaker: Narrator
901.text: He pointed at a paragraph towards the end of the document.

902.speaker: Titus Gordion
902.text: "After thoroughly scanning the document, we found a palimpsest. A spot where older text had been scratched off and replaced."

903.speaker: Titus Gordion
903.text: "As it turns out, Duchess Azaro was not His Majesty's first choice for security councilor."

904.speaker: Player_Romus
904.text: "You're saying she snuck into my father's room to amend the order?"

908.speaker: Player_Romus
908.text: "He wanted you for the job after all?"
908.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_InvestigationFinalQs_SecurityCandidate"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.SalExonerated"] == true) == false)

909.speaker: Player_Romus
909.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_InvestigationFinalQs_SecurityCandidate"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.SalExonerated"] == true) == false)

925.speaker: Titus Gordion
925.text: "I never told you because I was embarrassed to have petitioned. I believed the King rejected me due to my lack of experience."

926.speaker: Titus Gordion
926.text: "But it seems that's not what happened."

928.speaker: Player_Romus
928.text: "Why wouldn't he want Lucita for the position? She was the daughter of one of his most trusted advisors."

936.speaker: Titus Gordion
936.text: "My guess is she hoped to persuade him to change his mind. When he stood firm, she resorted to other means."

940.speaker: Titus Gordion
940.text: "Charitably, perhaps she only meant to incapacitate him. Unless, of course, her father informed her about the King's mandragora ritual."

942.speaker: Titus Gordion
942.text: "He may have been suspicious of her motivations. A woman that age, still unmarried, jostling for a seat closer to the crown..."

944.speaker: Titus Gordion
944.text: "Your father could have taken it himself. His medicine stores were cleared out long before this investigation began."

948.speaker: Titus Gordion
948.text: "There's still a small possibility that either Hugo or the Grand Wiseman slipped the poison to him."

949.speaker: Titus Gordion
949.text: "Alternately, the Grand Vizier could have administered it to him. The two of them were alone in your father's room for several minutes."

950.speaker: Titus Gordion
950.text: "But the discovery of the vial in Lucita's possession, combined with the motive I've just unearthed, strongly points towards her as our primary suspect."

953.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
953.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_FinalInvestigationClues_OtherExplanation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_InvestigationFinalQs_WhyNotLucita"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_InvestigationFinalQs_SecurityCandidate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_InvestigationFinalQs_SnuckIn"] == true

955.speaker: Player_Romus
955.text: "I've heard enough. What does the Duchess herself have to say about all this?"
955.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.SalExonerated"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_FinalInvestigationClues_OtherExplanation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_InvestigationFinalQs_WhyNotLucita"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_InvestigationFinalQs_SecurityCandidate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_InvestigationFinalQs_SnuckIn"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseAzaro_Conquered"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true) == false)

956.speaker: Titus Gordion
956.text: "We'll find out shortly. I sent her a summons. She should be arriving any minute."

960.speaker: Titus Gordion
960.text: "Nothing, sir. Even under heavy interrogation, the prisoner refuses to say a word."

961.speaker: Player_Romus
961.text: "I knew I did the right thing by naming you my security councilor. This just confirms it."

965.speaker: Player_Romus
965.text: "He's the only other person who possibly could've known about the ritual Sal and my father were performing. He took advantage of it."

969.speaker: Player_Romus
969.text: "I have changed my mind. We will charge Sal Ignacius with the murder after all."
969.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.SalExonerated"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Sal_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.SalExonerated"] == true)

973.speaker: Player_Romus
973.text: "Come on. We all know he's guilty. He must finally be made to answer for his crime."

974.speaker: Player_Romus
974.text: "The wolfsbane was a red herring. My father and Lucita were probably both taking it for medicinal reasons."

978.speaker: Titus Gordion
978.text: "I'll have the Grand Wiseman apprehended immediately, then."

982.speaker: Lucita Azaro
982.text: "And I haven't been in the loop on Rizian affairs since the new government was established."

983.speaker: Narrator
983.text: Lucita folded her arms. She avoided looking at either me or Titus.

984.speaker: Lucita Azaro
984.text: "That night, your father summoned me to his quarters in secrecy. I do remember finding it unusual that Captain Gordion was not on duty."

985.speaker: Lucita Azaro
985.text: "He told me that after much deliberation, he had decided to approve me for a seat on the Royal Council."

986.speaker: Lucita Azaro
986.text: "He said... he said that God Himself had told him that I was the only one who could take back Pales."

990.speaker: Lucita Azaro
990.text: "Why would I have murdered His Majesty after that? If anything, Captain Gordion got wind of the conversation and killed the king himself."

991.speaker: Player_Romus
991.text: "Did you promise my father you'd retake Pales?"

993.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
993.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

994.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
994.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

995.speaker: Lucita Azaro
995.text: "For heaven's sake... Who are you going to believe, Your Majesty, Ironjaw or your own wife?"
995.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

996.speaker: Lucita Azaro
996.text: "Listen to him, Your Majesty! Are you really going to let him treat the heiress to House Azaro like that?"
996.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

1001.speaker: Player_Romus
1001.text: "Where's the guardsman who covered for Titus that night? Can he corroborate any of this?"

1009.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1009.text: "I humored him. I thought I'd be able to stall for time until my father recovered."

1010.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1010.text: "I didn't know at the time that Valero and the General had been planning their own Pales conquest."

1011.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1011.text: "But wouldn't you know? God was right. I did retake Pales."

1015.speaker: Titus Gordion
1015.text: "The war was your family's plan, not God's."

1016.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1016.text: "Perhaps it's good that His Majesty didn't live long enough to find out God was wrong."

1017.speaker: Titus Gordion
1017.text: "I don't believe for a second that war with Pales wasn't your intention all along."

1021.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1021.text: "I wouldn't be surprised if, in all this excitement, you forgot to mention to the King that you take wolfsbane yourself."

1023.speaker: Titus Gordion
1023.text: "It's unfortunate, Your Majesty. After I dismissed him, he seemingly vanished off the map."

1024.speaker: Titus Gordion
1024.text: "Almost as if someone made him disappear."

1028.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1028.text: "Admit it, Captain Gordion. The Golden Guard expansion wasn't enough. Even with the Royal Council dissolved, you see me as an obstacle to power."

1032.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1032.text: "Admit it, Captain Gordion. The Golden Guard expansion wasn't enough. You're still hungry for my council seat."

1034.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1034.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_LucitaInterrogation_PoisonHow"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.SalExonerated"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_LucitaInterrogation_Wolfsbane"] == false

1036.speaker: Player_Romus
1036.text: “What's this about you taking wolfsbane, Captain Gordion?"
1036.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.SalExonerated"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_LucitaInterrogation_PoisonHow"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.SalExonerated"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_LucitaInterrogation_Wolfsbane"] == false)

1037.speaker: Narrator
1037.text: Titus bowed his head in shame.

1038.speaker: Titus Gordion
1038.text: "It's a medicine, Your Majesty. I occasionally make use of it when the pain from my old boxing injury becomes too much to bear."

1039.speaker: Titus Gordion
1039.text: "But if Duchess Azaro knew I was taking it, she could've used it to implicate me."

1045.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1045.text: "What a tight ship you run, Captain Gordion. Guards disappearing here and running off there."
